title: CORE-7011 · SHARED: FAQ quick-nav — 16px missing BELOW the first item (title says top)
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7011](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7011) ## The ticket title is wrong — and the real defect is next door The first item is **not** missing top spacing. Top spacing matches live exactly: | top gap (panel top → first item top) | live | clone | |---|---|---| | `/faqs/directors` and `/faqs/basics` @ 1440 / 1024 / 768 / 360 | **11px** | **11px** — MATCH | 11px = 10px panel `padding-top` + 1px border, identical on both. First `
  • ` `margin-top: 0`, first `` `padding-top: 8px` — same on both. **The stated premise does not reproduce at any width on any page.** What is actually missing is **16px BELOW** the first item, which on live separates the "FAQ Homepage" link from the topic list: | | live | clone (before) | delta | |---|---|---|---| | first item height | **62px** | 46px | **−16** | | every other item | 46px | 46px | MATCH | | gap between item boxes | 0px | 0px | MATCH | So the first item is special only in its own height, and the spacing lives *inside* the box — there is no inter-item margin anywhere on either site. Constant at 1440 / 1024 / 768 / 360, two pages, with a third spot-checked. ## Mechanism Live wraps the first label in `

    ` carrying `margin-bottom: 16px`, which makes that one anchor 62px tall. The clone renders a bare text node, so it collapses to the standard 46px. Reproduced as `padding-bottom` on the first anchor rather than a margin: 8px + 16px = 24px (`pb-6`). Padding cannot collapse, and it keeps the spacing inside the anchor exactly where live has it. `py-2` is split into `pt-2 pb-2` so the `pb-6` override does not depend on Tailwind's shorthand ordering. ## After | viewport | first item h | other items | panel height | live panel | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1440 | **62** ✅ | 46 ✅ | **1172** ✅ | 1172 | | 1024 | **62** ✅ | 46 ✅ | **1172** ✅ | 1172 | | 768 | **62** ✅ | 46 ✅ | 1172 | 1192 — see below | | 360 | **62** ✅ | 46 ✅ | 1292 | 1312 — see below | Top gap stays 11px at all four widths, unchanged. ## Two further findings, deliberately not fixed here **(a) A separate 20px, below the LAST item, under 1023px.** Live gives `li:last-child` `margin-bottom: 20px` under a max-width query (boundary probed: 20px at 1000, 0px at 1023 — it sits on the repo's existing `min-[1023px]:` breakpoint); the clone has 0 at every width. That is the whole of the remaining panel-height gap at 768 and 360 in the table above — different item, different breakpoint, its own ticket. **(b) The first label's colour looks like a regression.** Live paints "FAQ Homepage" `rgb(0,0,0)` — set on that inner `

    `, not on the `` (live's `` is `rgb(89,89,89)` like every other item). The clone paints `rgb(89,89,89)`. Commit `7c82c26` removed a `linkHome: 'text-[rgb(var(--black))]'` on the grounds that live is grey, which reads as having measured the `` rather than the `

    ` that actually paints the text. Verified black on live at 8 widths. If confirmed it rides on the same `linkHome` hook this PR reintroduces — but it is a colour change on a different ticket, so I have left it out. ## Checks - `bun run ts` clean · `bun run build` green - measured with the dropdown opened by a real click, all queries scoped inside the opened panel
acceptanceCriteria: First quick-nav item is 62px tall, matching live; every other item stays 46px.
Top gap stays 11px — it already matched live and must not move.
Holds at 1440 / 1024 / 768 / 360 on at least two FAQ topic pages.
Two secondary findings (20px under the last item below 1023px; first-label colour) filed separately.
